sections.title: Double Majors and Minors

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students wishing to complete a second major or a minor in addition to a Data Science (DATA) major must satisfy all DATA requirements.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least 34 upper division units must be allocated exclusively to the DATA major.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: This includes at least nine units from each of the lists under the sub-headings Business Administration, Computing Science, and Statistics.

sections.note: Units used to satisfy DATA upper division requirements beyond these 34 can be applied simultaneously to the other major, minor or honours.
